lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Highroller,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: do you prefer games

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: with psychological elements,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: or games that rely purely on skill?
I prefer having some psychological strategy in the mix.
I prefer purely skill-based games.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: It looks like we're the same.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I find them more interesting.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Looks like we're on completely opposite sides.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I prefer games with some psychological strategy.
Why do you prefer them, Rouge?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I find it fascinating

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: to observe the subtle changes in someone's expression or behavior,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: and to see how they react

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: in different situations.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I also enjoy

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: seeing their surprise

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: when they realize I've seen through their actions.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Of course,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: hiding my expressions

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: while doing so is quite a challenge,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: but the sense of accomplishment I get from winning

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: makes it all worthwhile.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Maintaining a consistent poker face

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: is a small pleasure in and of itself.
You really do have an innate talent for this.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I guess so.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: It's in my nature, I suppose.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Whenever I compete in games

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: where I get to employ some psychological strategies,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I get even more fired up.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I think the customers may have taken notice of this,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: and so they tend to

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: avoid playing those types of games with me.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: As a result, I haven't had the chance to indulge in them lately.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: So, Highballer,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: if you have some time,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: would you like to come visit Coin Rush

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: and play a game with me?
Sure, I'll stop by later.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I can't wait!

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Take care on your way here.
